title: 7 Brain Networks Found No Left-Brain Personality Type
hook: Seven brain networks failed the personality-side test.
closing: Your brain divides tasks, not your entire personality.
question: Were you labeled left- or right-brained?

segments.say: Language is 96% left-dominant in right-handers. Specialized tasks do not create a left-brained personality.
Across 7 brain networks, the personality split never appeared. The popular label is not visible in the wiring.
About 200 million nerve fibers connect both halves. Your brain works as a coordinated system.
